title: RepurposeRequested
description: One piece of text somebody wants turned into several shorter ones. Unlike the other commands, the whole instruction travels in the event: the asking system holds no job of its own to read it back from. Keys are snake_case, not the camelCase the rest of leaf uses: this travels inside a Liquid envelope, whose own fields (event_id, occurred_at, event_type, owner_unit_ref) are snake_case and pinned byte-exact by signed golden vectors. The shape follows the wire.

job_id.description: The job to report the work against, created by the pipeline if it does not exist yet.

session_id.description: The working session the request belongs to, which is where the brand voice and the defaults come from.

context.description: The text to work from, in full. Not a reference to an asset: a repurpose can be asked of words that were never put in.

formats.description: Which shapes to write. Anything outside the list is dropped rather than refused, and a request left with none is not worked.

channel.description: Where the result is headed, which changes how it is written. Free text: the channels belong to whoever publishes.

objective.description: What the result is for, in the vocabulary of whoever asked.

instructions.description: Anything else the asker wants said, in their own words.

use_brand_voice.description: Whether to write in the brand voice held for the session. False writes neutrally.

language.description: BCP-47 tag of the language to write in. Detected from the context when absent.
